rules.text: The advertised price has to include every fee the dealer means to charge: freight, PDI, admin fees and pre-installed extras like etching or nitrogen. Only HST and licensing can be added on top.
There's no cooling-off period. Once you sign, the contract is binding.
A deposit with no signed contract can be asked back at any time, and the dealer has to return it.
Put any conditions in the written contract. Verbal promises are hard to prove.
On a used car, you can cancel within 90 days of delivery if the dealer didn't disclose past taxi, police or daily-rental use, a salvage or rebuilt brand, or the real kilometres.
